Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: architecture PNG for a hardware repository
Primary request: Draw a precise clean engineering block diagram for chipyard.DualRocketNVDLAConfig, IP3, highlighting NVDLA additions relative to a plain dual Rocket SoC.
Style: flat technical diagram, white background, dark navy readable type, thin clean orthogonal connectors, restrained teal inherited blocks and orange new blocks, generous spacing, landscape, high resolution. No 3D chip art.
Title: "IP3 — Dual Rocket + NVDLA small"
Subtitle: "Orange = additions relative to IP1"
Inside a large ChipTop boundary, arrange:
Top left two separate teal CPU blocks "Rocket hart 0 · RV64 + FPU" and "Rocket hart 1 · RV64 + FPU". Under each its own "L1 I$ 32 KiB · D$ 32 KiB".
Middle-left horizontal teal "TileLink system bus (SBUS)" connected to both CPU cache blocks.
Below it "Shared inclusive L2 · 512 KiB" connected toward a bottom "64-bit AXI4 memory port". Outside ChipTop below memory port, label "External memory system" and "256 MiB address window at 0x80000000". Do not imply DRAM or a DDR PHY is on chip.
From system fabric branch to teal "64 KiB scratchpad · 0x08000000" and "Peripheral bus (PBUS)" with existing teal "UART · CLINT · PLIC", "Boot ROM · JTAG debug · Serial TileLink", and "Clock / reset controls". Main clock is external, no on-chip PLL.
Right half is a large orange outlined group "NEW: NVDLA nv_small · INT8". Inside show readable block groups: "Convolution: CDMA → CBUF 128 KiB → CSC → CMAC A/B → CACC"; "SDP · elementwise / conversion"; "PDP · pooling"; "CDP · LUT / LRN hardware"; "MCIF · 64-bit AXI DMA"; "CFGROM · control · interrupt". Use clear grouped rectangles; do not wire an invented serial chain through SDP,PDP,CDP. These engines share MCIF access.
Between PBUS and NVDLA control draw orange small box "NEW: TileLink → APB" with bidirectional control connector, label "Registers: 0x10040000–0x1007ffff".
Between NVDLA MCIF and SBUS draw orange small box "NEW: AXI4 → TileLink adapters" with bidirectional connector labeled "Coherent DMA".
Draw one orange dashed arrow from NVDLA interrupt to PLIC labeled "New device interrupt".
Footer within generous margin: "Separate accelerator variant: no FFT in IP3" and "Architectural view · not a physical floorplan".
Constraints: exactly two CPUs; exactly one NVDLA group; CBUF stays inside NVDLA; no FFT, Gemmini, GPU, BDMA or CVSRAM blocks; distinguish PBUS control from SBUS DMA. Do not claim timing or completed physical implementation. Text legibility and correct connections are more important than decorative detail.
